tonight.headline: Loveland tonight; the win is in hand, Taylor is on the block
body: Bad news first: Jonathan Taylor scored 6.7 in a 42-7 loss and the Colts are in "active and ongoing" trade talks for him, with an unconfirmed Broncos report on Sunday (B/R 31 Oct; Heavy via Yahoo 2 Nov). Indianapolis have not named a Week 9 quarterback. Josh Jacobs may still be suspended when the NFL review ends (Heavy 1 Nov).
Bloodsports lead Metcalf Gala 137.98 to 82.40; ESPN projects 149.8 to 96.6 after Bears-Seahawks. Loveland plays tonight with no designation. 2-6 by tomorrow. Nothing to set.

case.label: What is left
case.body: Loveland for Bloodsports; Metcalf Gala have about 14 projected points to play and trail by 56.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Only a Monday-night line from their remaining player above 55 points.

worthALook.name: Mike Washington Jr.
worthALook.lead: Kubiak's call, not an injury — a free-agent look only if it repeats.

case.label: The player
case.body: 25 carries for 83 at the Jets; Jeanty 2 carries (NBC 1 Nov; ABC7 2 Nov). Kubiak: "That's my call." No injury reported.

case.label: Why not
case.body: IPADE priority never resets and Bloodsports carry four startable backs. One unexplained game.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A second week as the lead with Jeanty healthy, and Washington still unrostered after claims clear — then a free-agent add costs no priority.
